description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework with native HTTP/2 + HTTP/3, AI‑ready routing and edge‑first deployment – the Express‑style API re‑engineered for 2026.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.177‑daily ships native HTTP/3 (QUIC) support, a compile‑time type‑safe router that can invoke LLMs directly, and out‑of‑the‑box edge runtime adapters (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Bun, Deno). All of this is delivered in a zero‑dependency package under 10 KB, giving developers the speed of Fastify with the ergonomics of Express while future‑proofing for AI‑centric workloads.
download_hooks: Sub‑millisecond latency on HTTP/3 – the fastest open‑source Node.js stack for real‑time APIs.
Zero‑dependency bundle < 10 KB keeps cold‑start times at a bare minimum on edge platforms.
Full TypeScript type safety eliminates a class of runtime bugs before you even run the code.
Express‑style middleware syntax means you’re productive from day 1, no steep learning curve.
Built‑in AI‑ready routing lets you attach LLMs or GenAI services with a single line of code.
